new.name: command_fields
new.source:
fn command_fields(j : Json, names : List(String)) : Unit =
  match j of
    JObj(xs) =>
      demand(length(xs) == length(names), "INVALID_COMMAND")
      demand(all(\(n) -> length(filter(\(kv) -> fst(kv) == n, xs)) == 1, names), "INVALID_COMMAND")
    _ => reject("INVALID_COMMAND")

new.name: command_int
new.source:
fn command_int(j : Json, name : String) : Int =
  match command_field(j, name) of
    JInt(n) =>
      demand(n >= 1 && n <= 2147483647, "INVALID_COMMAND")
      n
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_COMMAND")
      0

new.name: command_lookup
new.source:
fn command_lookup(xs : List((String, Json)), name : String) : Json =
  match xs of
    Nil =>
      reject("INVALID_COMMAND")
      JNull
    Cons((k, v), rest) => if k == name then v else command_lookup(rest, name)

new.source:
fn valid_row(row : List(Json), columns : List(Column)) : Bool =
  length(row) == length(columns)
    && all(
        \(i) ->
          let value = at(row, i) in
          let column = at(columns, i) in
          bounded_value(value)
            && (value_type(value) == column.kind || is_null(value) && column.nullable),
        range(0, length(columns)),
      )

new.name: view_name_ok
new.source:
fn view_name_ok(s : String) : Bool =
  byte_len(s) >= 1 && byte_len(s) <= 40
    && byte_at(s, 0) >= 97 && byte_at(s, 0) <= 122
    && all(
        \(i) ->
          let c = byte_at(s, i) in
          c >= 97 && c <= 122 || digit(c) || c == 45,
        range(0, byte_len(s)),
      )
